meta.name: dmv_scenario_bank
meta.description: DMV-aligned violation scenario bank used by the APL rule engine. Each scenario s_j = (nu_j, E_j, r_j) carries a violation type, a set of evidentiary predicates, and a deterministic decision rule. Predicate phrasings are written as privacy-neutral observations: they describe road state, vehicle state and signage, never identity attributes.
sources: State driver handbook (right-of-way, signal, stop-line and speed chapters)
Federal MUTCD signage and signal definitions
Uniform Vehicle Code article on traffic-control-device obedience

scenarios.legal_reference: Obedience to steady circular red indication

predicates.text: the traffic signal facing the vehicle shows a steady red light
a vehicle crosses the painted stop line at the intersection
the vehicle is moving forward rather than standing still

scenarios.legal_reference: Required stop at a regulatory STOP sign

predicates.text: a regulatory stop sign is posted at the approach
the vehicle is moving forward rather than standing still
a vehicle crosses the painted stop line at the intersection

scenarios.legal_reference: Driving on roadways laned for traffic

predicates.text: lane markings separating the travel lanes are visible on the road surface
a vehicle body overlaps the lane dividing line
no turn indicator lamp is illuminated on the vehicle

scenarios.legal_reference: Turning movements prohibited by posted sign

predicates.text: a sign prohibiting the turning movement is posted at the intersection
a vehicle is executing a turning movement at the intersection
the vehicle is inside the intersection box

scenarios.legal_reference: Yielding to pedestrians within a marked crosswalk

predicates.text: a marked crosswalk is painted across the roadway
a pedestrian is inside the marked crosswalk
a vehicle occupies part of the marked crosswalk
the vehicle is moving forward rather than standing still

scenarios.legal_reference: Compliance with posted maximum speed limit

predicates.text: a posted speed limit sign is visible along the roadway
the vehicle appears with strong motion blur relative to the static background
the road is an urban street rather than a highway segment
a lane is marked as reserved for buses
a passenger car or truck rather than a transit bus occupies the reserved lane
the sign indicating the restricted hours is in force
a railroad grade crossing is present on the roadway
the crossing gate arm is lowered across the road
a vehicle is positioned on or beyond the crossing tracks

scenarios.legal_reference: Operation on approach of an authorized emergency vehicle

predicates.text: an emergency vehicle with activated warning lights is present in the scene
the vehicle is moving forward rather than standing still
the surrounding vehicles have not moved toward the shoulder
a no parking or no standing sign is posted at the curb
a vehicle is stationary along the curb
the curb is painted in a color that marks a restricted zone

scenarios.legal_reference: Following another vehicle more closely than is reasonable

predicates.text: a lead vehicle occupies the same travel lane ahead
the visible gap between the two vehicles spans less than two vehicle lengths
both vehicles are moving along the roadway

scenarios.legal_reference: Obedience to temporary traffic-control devices in a work zone

predicates.text: cones barrels or temporary barriers delimit an active work zone
a travel lane is closed by the temporary traffic control devices
a vehicle travels inside the closed lane
